رُشْدٌ an inf. n. of 1. (S, L, Msb, K.) ―
-b2- [As a simple subst., Rectitude.] Also Maturity of in- tellect, and rectitude of actions, and good management of affairs. (TA in art. انس: see 4 in that art.) [Hence, بَلَغَ رُشْدَهُ He attained to years of discretion, when he was able of himself to take, or follow, a right way or course: a phrase of frequent occurrence.]
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
